title: Nepali-English Code-Mixed Speech Recognition: Data Preparation and Adaptation of a Speech Foundation Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.13512v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Nepali speakers regularly mix English words into conversation, but multilingual speech recognisers often struggle with language switches and the writing script used for English words. We study how to adapt SraVaani, a 449M-parameter hybrid TDT-CTC model, using a 172.8-hour corpus covering six Nepali speech domains. Its pretrained tokenizer does not support digits and several common symbols. Rather than replace it or discard these recordings, we generate Nepali and English readings for numbers and use zero-shot ASR output to select a plausible form. Full fine-tuning reduces test word error rate (WER) from 48.6% to 17.1%; a 12-epoch run reaches 16.3%, compared with 16.4% for fine-tuned Whisper large-v3-turbo. Freezing the encoder increases WER to 25.5%, while excluding numeric clips raises WER on numeric test speech from 14.3% to 21.3%. translated_title: 尼泊尔语-英语码混合语音识别：数据准备与语音基础模型的适配
translated_abstract: 尼泊尔语使用者在对话中经常夹杂英语单词，但多语言语音识别系统往往难以应对语言切换以及英语单词所使用的书写文字。我们研究了如何使用一个覆盖六个尼泊尔语语音领域、总时长172.8小时的语料库来适配SraVaani——一个拥有4.49亿参数的TDT-CTC混合模型。该模型的预训练分词器不支持数字和若干常用符号。我们没有更换分词器或丢弃这些录音，而是为数字生成尼泊尔语和英语两种读法，并利用零样本ASR输出来选择合理的形式。全量微调将测试词错误率（WER）从48.6%降至17.1%；12个epoch的训练达到16.3%，而微调后的Whisper large-v3-turbo为16.4%。冻结编码器会使WER升至25.5%，而排除含数字的音频片段会使数字测试语音上的WER从14.3%升至21.3%。我们还在FLEURS数据集上，分别使用其原始参考文本和混合书写文字的替代版本进行了评估。
tldr: 本研究通过为分词器不支持的数字生成尼泊尔语与英语读法并借助零样本ASR选取合理形式，成功将语音基础模型SraVaani适配到尼泊尔语-英语码混合语音识别任务，将词错误率从48.6%降至16.3%，优于微调后的Whisper large-v3-turbo。
en_tdlr: This work adapts the SraVaani speech foundation model for Nepali-English code-mixed speech recognition by generating both Nepali and English readings for unsupported digits and selecting plausible forms via zero-shot ASR output, reducing WER from 48.6% to 16.3% and outperforming fine-tuned Whisper large-v3-turbo.
